title: Spatiotemporal clonal architecture of the newborn mouse forebrain
title_zh: 新生小鼠大脑半球的时空克隆体系结构
abstract: How hundreds of cell types of the mammalian forebrain emerge from a limited set of progenitor cells during development remains largely unknown1-3, and studies so far have overwhelmingly focused on the cerebral cortex. Here, to fill this gap, we applied lentiviral barcoding across the major subdivisions of the mouse forebrain: cortex, hippocampus, striatum, thalamus and olfactory bulb. We registered cellular profiles to their anatomical distribution using spatial transcriptomics, creating an atlas of clonal cell lineage relationships across a newborn mouse forebrain. We uncover previously unrecognized differences in generation of ventral and dorsal medium spiny neurons, as well as unexplored lineage relationships between late-born medium spiny neurons, striatal astrocytes and distinct subpopulations of the olfactory bulb neurons. We show that clones of GABAergic (γ-aminobutyric acid-producing) neurons with broad regional dispersion are enriched for genes implicated in neurodevelopmental disorders. Our results highlight a developmental principle whereby glutamatergic neurons and astrocytes are clonally related and retained within their region of origin, whereas GABAergic neurons are clonally related to oligodendrocyte precursor cells but disperse extensively across brain regions. Together, our findings will serve as a foundational reference for studies of mammalian forebrain development and its disorders.
abstract_zh: 哺乳动物大脑半球中数百种细胞类型如何从有限的前体细胞在发育过程中产生仍大多未知1-3，且迄今的研究主要集中在大脑皮层。为填补这一空白，我们在小鼠大脑半球的主要亚区（皮层、海马体、纹状体、丘脑和嗅球）应用了慢病毒条形码标记。我们利用空间转录组学将细胞特征注册到其解剖分布，从而构建了新生小鼠大脑半球中克隆细胞谱系关系的图谱。我们发现胞嘧啶胺基质产生的中间神经元在腹侧和背侧的生成存在此前未被认识的差异，以及晚出生的中间神经元、纹状体星形胶质细胞以及嗅球不同亚群之间的未探索的谱系关系。我们表明，产生γ-氨基丁酸（GABA）的神经元克隆在广泛的区域分布中富集了与神经发育障碍相关的基因。我们的研究结果突出了一个发育原则：谷氨酸能神经元和星形胶质细胞在克隆上相关并保留在其原发区域，而GABA能神经元则与胶原细胞前体细胞在克隆上相关，但广泛分布于大脑不同区域。这些发现将作为哺乳动物大脑半球发育及其疾病研究的基础参考。
